purpose: Offline-first A2UI v1.0, v0.9.1, v0.9, and v0.8 toolkit: strict schema and graph validation, deterministic v0.8/v0.9-to-v1.0 normalization, curated interactive surface composition, zero-coupling JSON-to-A2UI projection (project), zero-daemon static HTML previewing, Precision Noir React/WebCore/Lit renderer scaffolding, pinned a2ui-project/a2ui spec lookup, and an attachable Empire knowledge pack.
scope: Python 3.11+ standard-library CLI (zero mandatory pip dependencies) for validating JSON/JSONL/Markdown A2UI payloads against vendored a2ui-project/a2ui (google/A2UI) schemas, upgrading legacy v0.8/v0.9 surfaces to canonical v1.0 (@path, @call, @accessibility, @checks, UAX #31 IDs while keeping ChildList.path and updateDataModel.path unprefixed), composing 8 validated operator surface templates, projecting arbitrary structured JSON into strict A2UI v1.0 surfaces via project (auto, plan-approval, health-deck, data-briefing), generating offline self-contained file:// HTML previews with live dataModel bindings and action inspection, preview-first scaffolding of React/WebCore/Lit Precision Noir integration kits, checking project @a2ui/* drift, offline catalog/docs lookup, and attaching the a2ui Empire knowledge pack.

discovery.setup: Python 3.11+ standard library only (zero mandatory pip dependencies). Optional Node.js 18+ only when integrating JS/TS renderer packages.
examples: Validate all ```a2ui blocks in this Markdown file against A2UI v1.0 strict rules
Upgrade this legacy A2UI v0.8 or v0.9 payload to canonical v1.0 with @path and UAX #31 IDs
Compose an A2UI v1.0 ship-call approval card or multi-field intake form
Project a CLI planSha256 preview JSON or doctor health JSON into an interactive A2UI v1.0 surface with legends-a2ui project
Render this A2UI JSON into an offline interactive file:// HTML preview
Scaffold a Precision Noir @a2ui/react and @a2ui/web_core renderer kit into my web app
Check my project's @a2ui/* packages for version drift against upstream a2ui-project/a2ui
Attach the A2UI v1.0 knowledge pack to my Empire vault
discovery.not_for: Hosting live multi-tenant A2UI agent backends, provisioning cloud servers, bypassing URL/secret safety gates, or spawning detached background web servers for previews.
